audience: online shop owners and managers who run a WiziShop store

useCases.title: Check products, prices and stock
useCases.text: List the products of a shop, filtered by status or SKU. Open one product to see its prices and stock.

useCases.title: Review orders by status
useCases.text: List orders, filtered by a status code range and sorted by a field. Open one order to see its lines, totals and status.

useCases.title: Find the customer of an order
useCases.text: Look up an order by its public id. Search customers by name or email to find the buyer.

useCases.title: List the categories of a shop
useCases.text: List the product categories of a shop. Get the shop name, domain, currency and status for context.

useCases.title: List the shops this login can use
useCases.text: List the shops that this login can access, with their ids. Pass a shop id to the other tools to choose a shop.
